rationale:
The new rule targets claims that are both lowrisk and lowvalue: it automatically processes claims under$50,000 with a fraud score of 0.75 or less, and also covers airlinefault incidents that are under$75,000 with an even stricter fraud score of 0.3. Backtesting shows that this rule applies to 181 claims in the training data and 87 in the heldout set, and it achieves a 70.1% success ratewell above the 43.8% baselineindicating a clear improvement in accurate

Diff: Previously, All claims < $50k auto-processed. The data shows a pattern, so this proposes auto-processing claims that match: (claim_amount < 50000 AND fraud_score <= 0.75) OR (incident_type == airline_fault AND fraud_score <= 0.3 AND claim_amount <= 75000).
